verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data and brand-data API, not an agent or AI client that consumes external tools, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it is a category error. The MCP evidence (docs-13, probe-3) shows Context.dev acting as an MCP server that AI clients connect to. That is the server role, so it does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
